'''2007 New York State Championship Joe Pinto DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
